cuerpo.name: Mihon v0.21.3
cuerpo.body:
Consider supporting the development on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/mihon/membership) or [OpenCollective](https://opencollective.com/mihon/contribute) to keep Mihon improving!

Check out the [past release notes](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases) if you're upgrading from an earlier version.

<!-->

> [!NOTE]
>
> ### This is the last major version to support Tachiyomi's backup format (.tachibk) and extensions made for it.
>
> After this version, Mihon won't be able to restore backups in Tachiyomi's backup format (.tachibk). The next version will also drop compatibility with extensions made for Tachiyomi (1.4 extensions). This is being done to reduce maintenance burden and simplify things for upcoming features.
>
> From the next update, the only way to restore a .tachibk backup will be to restore it on this version and then update to the latest version.

### ✨ New Features
- Added a Time Format setting to show times in 12 or 24 hour format, or to follow your language or system (Settings → Appearance) (@MajorTanya)
- Added a "Redact sensitive headers" setting (on by default) that hides login tokens from logs, so they are safe to share (Settings → Advanced) (@MajorTanya)

### ⚙️ Changes
- Library updates now start with the sources that have the most entries in your library (@AntsyLich)

### 🚀 Improvements
- Creating and restoring backups is faster and uses much less memory, so big libraries no longer run out of memory (@NGB-Was-Taken, @AntsyLich)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed WebView crashing for sources that set an Origin header (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed WebView sending a source's headers to other sites (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed downloads not showing for entries of a source that shares its name with another source (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed covers reloading when removing an entry from your library (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the More tab icon pausing and then bouncing back when leaving the tab (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the Shizuku extension installer not being available with Sui (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the extension update count being hidden when tab names are long, like in German (@Sahil-669, @AntsyLich)

### 🧹 Removals
- Removed the "Split tall images" download setting with it being handled in the reader directly (@AntsyLich)

### 🔧 Under the hood
- The download queue screen was rebuilt (@AntsyLich)
- Updated OkHttp, which now blocks the compromised eMudhra certificates on devices without Google Play Services (@renovate)

<!-->

## And in [v0.21.2](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases/tag/v0.21.2)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed Comick showing reading progress with long decimal numbers (@MajorTanya)
- Fixed updating from v0.20.x failing on some older databases, which left the app on the updating screen or crashing on launch (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when using the back gesture while the reader or a dialog was closing (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed Kitsu login failing with "Failed to bypass Cloudflare" (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the tracker start date being a day off when adding tracking to an entry you already read, in some timezones (@hazptr)
- Fixed the paged reader crashing when moving to another chapter with "Split wide pages" on (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when opening the filters of some sources (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when installing an extension on devices where the system installer can't ask for confirmation (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when tapping in the long strip reader as it closed (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed some chapters downloaded before v0.21.0 no longer showing as downloaded (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the app slowing down or running out of memory when many requests to a site hit a Cloudflare challenge at once (@tigeryu8900, @AntsyLich)

<!-->

## And in [v0.21.1](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases/tag/v0.21.1)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed refreshing chapters failing with the app language set to Arabic or another language with its own digits (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash on launch on some Samsung devices running Android 9 to 11 (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the start and resume button going under the taskbar on tablets (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when updating an extension while others were installing (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed entries without a date added jumping to the top when sorting by date added after updating from v0.20.x (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the app closing when a WebView page crashed (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed installing or updating an extension sometimes cancelling the install of another one (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed updating from v0.20.x taking up to hours on libraries with many duplicate entries (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the app staying on the updating screen for good when updating its data failed, and updating failing on leftover data of deleted entries (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed library updates ignoring the smart update restrictions for some entries (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed resuming a chapter sometimes opening the next chapter partway through in the right to left reader (@AntsyLich)

<!-->

## And in [v0.21.0](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases/tag/v0.21.0)

### ✨ New Features
- Added [Comick](https://comick.dev) tracker support (@MajorTanya)
- Added a "Load ahead only on Wi-Fi" reader option to save mobile data (@AntsyLich)
- Added an option to skip an app update (@AntsyLich)
- Added a progress screen while Mihon updates its data after an app update (@AntsyLich)
- Added `id:` search to more trackers: AniList, Bangumi, Kitsu, MangaUpdates, Shikimori and Hikka (@MajorTanya, @BrutuZ)
- Added refresh buttons in tracker settings to update your username and rating system (@MajorTanya)
- Kitsu now uses the rating system you picked on Kitsu (@MajorTanya, @Secozzi)
- Added an option to keep using installed extensions that don't match your content preferences (@AntsyLich)
- Added an option to turn off the extra suffix in downloaded chapter folder names (Settings → Advanced) (@choppeh, @AntsyLich)
- Local source now reads chapter dates from `ComicInfo.xml`, and downloads save them too (@MajorTanya)

### ⚙️ Changes
- Duplicate entries and chapters left over from older versions are now merged when you update. **This can't be undone, so make a backup before updating** (@AntsyLich)
- Extensions now only install and update from the repo they come from, to keep you safe from tampered extensions (@AntsyLich)
- Replaced the NSFW toggle for extensions with content preferences: Safe, Mixed and 18+ (@AntsyLich)
- Restoring a backup into your existing library now keeps your furthest read progress and the earliest date added (@AntsyLich)
- Refreshed the app's icons, and downloading chapters now show a wavy progress ring (@AntsyLich)
- App updates now download right from the update screen (@AntsyLich)
- Removing an entry from your library on its details screen now asks for confirmation (@WizaHX)
- Extension details now show which repo an extension comes from, with a link to its website (@AntsyLich)
- MangaBaka is now listed first among trackers (@AntsyLich)

### 🚀 Improvements
- Mihon is a lot faster, especially with big libraries: the library, history, updates, browse, statistics and entry details screens all open quicker, startup is faster, and the app stutters and freezes less (@AntsyLich)
- The reader loads pages faster and gets the next pages and chapter ready ahead of time (@AntsyLich)
- Downloads start faster, and queueing lots of chapters at once is much quicker (@AntsyLich)
- Smarter "next update" times for your library that follow each series' release schedule (@AntsyLich)
- Better chapter number detection (@AntsyLich)
- Extension setting changes now apply without restarting the app, and extension updates show up right after launch (@AntsyLich)
- Extensions that fail to load now tell you why, and can still be updated (@AntsyLich)
- Sources behind Cloudflare now fail sooner when you need to solve a challenge (@tigeryu8900)
- The extensions list now shows which repo each extension comes from (@AntsyLich)
- Tracker search improvements: MangaUpdates shows scores, searching again cancels the last search, and a clearer message when your AniList login has expired (@MajorTanya, @AntsyLich)
- Restoring a backup now uses the system file picker (@MajorTanya)
- Settings search can now find settings by their section name (@kaosjammo, @AntsyLich)
- The filter icon in Updates and Upcoming now shows when a filter is on (@Secozzi)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed "database is locked" crashes (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed crashes in some extensions (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed long strip stuttering between pages and using a lot of memory with very tall pages (@AntsyLich, @matheuswr89)
- Fixed several download issues, including duplicate files after pausing, chapters downloading twice, stuck downloads of removed chapters and downloaded chapters showing as not downloaded (@AntsyLich, @JoJoKorok, @choppeh)
- Fixed the next update time getting stuck on "Soon" (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed several backup restore issues with categories, trackers and sources whose extension isn't installed (@Secozzi, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed "Delete after reading" removing downloads in excluded categories, and not removing downloads of duplicate chapters (@mliem2k, @leodyversemilla07, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed chapter list issues when a refresh fails or a source lists a chapter twice, and the chapter selection clearing after new chapters download (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed reader tap navigation sometimes not responding (@mujina3)
- Fixed tracker issues including AniList rate limit errors, Shikimori "Unknown status: 0", wrong MangaBaka scores and dates, lost offline tracker updates and logins refreshing twice (@MajorTanya, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed reading time sometimes being counted twice, and tracker start dates resetting to 1970 after removing history (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed entries wrongly being flagged as duplicates (@Secozzi, @NarwhalHorns, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed global and migration search slowing the app down or getting stuck, and local source missing from global search (@choppeh, @mugetau)
- Fixed long strip zoom with side padding, and a gap after zooming in split screen (@WizaHX, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed local source not listing any chapters when one archive couldn't be read (@a-biad, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed chapters from excluded scanlators failing to open from notifications or links (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed download notifications missing or showing old info, and the app slowing down while many chapters are queued (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed default chapter settings not applying to entries added by long pressing them in a source (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the Updates screen and updates widget not showing useful information when empty, filtered or locked (@AMendoza180890, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed extension repo issues: removed repos coming back, repos without HTTPS failing to add, and cancelled installs still downloading (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when selecting a range of entries across categories, and being able to give a category an empty name (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed some actions not running when started from a dialog, and update checks running again when rotating the screen (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed editing the cover of an entry that isn't in your library (@quickdesh, @AntsyLich)
- Fixed library search when tapping the source name on an entry's details screen (@choppeh)
- Fixed "Hide missing chapter indicators" not hiding them in chapter headers (@kaosjammo)
- Fixed text between dollar signs disappearing from descriptions and notes (@renovate)

### 🧹 Removals
- Removed the "Use legacy decoder for long strip reader" setting, since long strip no longer needs it (@AntsyLich)

### 🔧 Under the hood
- Limited what extensions can access from the app (@AntsyLich)
- Updated how Mihon talks to Kitsu, AniList, Shikimori and Suwayomi (@MajorTanya, @Syer10)

<!-->

> [!TIP]
>
> ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with `mihon-v0.21.3.apk`

Check out the [past release notes](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases) if you’re upgrading from an earlier version. Consider [donating via Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/mihon/contribute) to help keep Mihon improving!

<!--> 

### ✨ New Features
- Added support for manga mass migration, allowing batch migration across sources (@AntsyLich, @jobobby04)
- Introduced user-defined manga notes (@imkunet, @AntsyLich)
- Enabled markdown support for manga descriptions with an optional to disable image loading (@Secozzi)
- Implemented full support for Android predictive back gesture navigation (@AntsyLich)
- Added an option to retain read manga when clearing the database (@AwkwardPeak7)
- Added an advanced setting to automatically update manga titles from the source (@FlaminSarge)
- Introduced two new themes: Nord, and Catppuccin with Mocha (dark) and Latte (light) variants featuring Mauve accent (@Riztard, @claymorwan)
- Expanded the set of Kaomojis displayed on empty and error screens (@ianfhunter)

### ⚙️ Improvements
- Significantly improve loading speed while browsing making it near instantaneous (@AntsyLich)
- Refactored library code for better performance with large manga collections (@AntsyLich)
- Enabled real-time metadata updates for non-library manga when browsing source (@AntsyLich)
- Prevented duplicate entries from appearing while browsing sources (@AntsyLich)
- Enhanced reader error handling by clearly displaying image load failures (@AwkwardPeak7)
- Passed source headers to failed image previews opened in WebView (@AwkwardPeak7)
- Enabled autofill for tracker login fields to improve ease of use (@AntsyLich)
- Improved the calculation of update intervals by using the median instead of the average (@Kladki)
- Added an option to hide missing chapter indicators in the manga list (@User826, @AntsyLich)

### 🔄 Changes
- Updated the duplicate manga dialog to show all similar entries, including chapter counts (@NarwhalHorns, @AntsyLich)
- Changed the default user agent string to Android Chrome for more accurate representation (@AntsyLich)
- Allow updates for manga without chapters, regardless of source restrictions (@AntsyLich)
- Adjusted local source chapter sorting to follow file explorer-like ordering (@AntsyLich)
- Changed the reader's "Keep screen on" setting to be disabled by default (@AntsyLich)
- Modified the tracker login button to show processing state (@AntsyLich)
- Updated Facebook and Reddit icons to match current branding (@Joehuu)
- Included the manga `initialized` status in backup files (@AwkwardPeak7)

### 🐞 Fixes
- Resolved issue where Bangumi search results included novel entries (@MajorTanya)
- Fixed behavior where the next chapter button would jump to the last page of current chapter (@perokhe)
- Addressed issue with backup sharing from notifications when the app is backgrounded (@JaymanR)
- Corrected failure in marking duplicate chapters as read in some scenarios (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed tooltips in the app bar obstructing user interactions (@Bartuzen)
- Removed unintended app permissions caused by Firebase misconfiguration (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed navigation issue after migrating duplicated entries from the History tab (@cuong-tran)
- Ensured non-interactive behavior for content beneath the source browse top bar (@AntsyLich)
- Resolved crash when using source sort filters without a prior selection (@AntsyLich)
- Corrected missing empty layout in certain browse source scenarios (@NarwhalHorns)
- Updated Pill components to adhere to the local text style (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed downloader halting due to failure in creating the manga download directory (@AntsyLich)
- Prevented unintended back navigation when pressing `Enter` on physical keyboards during search (@AwkwardPeak7)
- Ensured proper waiting behavior for Cloudflare challenge completion (@AwkwardPeak7)
